tool.name: nf-core nanolyse
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ gunzip -c $fastq | NanoLyse -r $fasta | gzip > ${prefix}.fastq.gz mv NanoLyse.log ${prefix}.nanolyse.log
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": nanolyse: \$(NanoLyse --version 2>&1 | sed -e "s/NanoLyse //g") END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
DNA contaminant removal using NanoLyse
